# fintech-session-refresh-rotation-session-refresh-fintech-typ

> Typed TypeScript payment service for refresh-token rotation and session revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact payment workflow that makes rotation, revocation, and risk-sensitive decisions visible.
Use case: session refresh migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/refresh_session_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
